summary: Mutate same namespace object for reopened declarations.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: combine
tests.input: namespace N { export const a=1 }; namespace N { export const b=2 }; console.log(N.a,N.b);

tests.name: identity
tests.input: namespace N { export const a=1 }; const x=N; namespace N { export const b=2 }; console.log(x===N);
